NOW SERVING BEER-FRIENDLY FARE IN BALLARD

Our menu is our unique take on American Pub Fare—great food that pairs with great beers. We cook from the plate backwards: with an intentional and unwavering focus on quality. The vast majority of our menu options are made from scratch, using our beer as an ingredient whenever possible. We know making that extra effort is worth it.

Ballard FAQs

Where is Reuben’s Brews Brewery & Taproom located?

You’ll find us in the heart of Ballard at 5010 14th Ave NW. Searching for a “brewery near me”? We’re your neighborhood spot for award-winning beer and good vibes.

What are your hours?

Our Ballard Brewery and Taproom is open daily from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.—perfect for lunch, post-work drinks, or enjoying a weekend day.

Can I order food for delivery or pickup from the Ballard Brewery & Taproom?

Yes! We now offer ordering for pickup and delivery. Use this link to place your order.

Is there parking at the Ballard Brewery & Taproom?

Street parking is available throughout the neighborhood. Most of it is non-time restricted and free!

Can I bring my family?

Absolutely! Our Ballard Taproom is family-friendly. Kids and well-behaved adults are always welcome.

Are dogs allowed?

At the Ballard Brewery, pups are welcome in our indoor and outdoor areas. We just ask that they stay on leash and enjoy the sunshine responsibly.

Do you serve food?

Yes! We offer a full menu of food options that pair perfectly with our beers.

Do you serve lunch?

Yes! Our full menu from our onsite kitchen is available at the Ballard Taproom starting at 11 AM daily.

Is vegetarian or vegan food available?

We have several vegetarian and vegan options at our Ballard Brewery. Additionally, several items can be altered to make them vegetarian and/or vegan at your request.

Do you take reservations?

Our Ballard Taproom operates on a first-come, first-served basis. For private events or large groups, check out our Private Events page.

Do you have gluten-free beer?

While we don’t brew gluten-free beer, we do offer cider, hard seltzer and non-alcoholic beverages for those avoiding gluten at our Ballard Brewery.

Can I buy beer to-go?

Yes! Our Ballard brewery offers packaged beer to-go—grab your favorites before you head home.

Do you fill growlers or crowlers?

Yes! Stop by the Ballard Taproom to fill your growler or pick up a fresh crowler of your favorite Reuben’s beer.

Do you have Reuben’s gear for sale?

Yes! We have a rotating variety of t-shirts, sweatshirts and hats, as well as accessories for you and your pups at our Ballard Taproom. Come in and check out our merchandise wall

Can I host a private event at the Ballard Brewery & Taproom?

Yes! We do offer partial or full buy outs of the taproom. We also have two dedicated private event spaces in the heart of Ballard. Visit our Private Events page to learn more about hosting your gathering at our Ballard Brewery space.

GRATITUESDAYS

Every month we host a few different local charities at Gratituesday events, and we donate $1 per pint / growler / set of three tasters to the organization. We have raised over $100,000 for local non-profits, one pint at a time with this program! Click here for the program details.

Gratituesdays take place at The Taproom (5010 14th Ave NW). If you'd like to request a date for your organization, please read about the requirements on our program page, where you can also submit a request.
